newsitem.title: UK: ING Bank/ING Barings seen best in emerging mkts.
newsitem.headline: ING Bank/ING Barings seen best in emerging mkts.

text.p: ING Bank/ING Barings has been voted the best operating bank in emerging markets, according to a poll conducted for UK-based Emerging Markets Investor magazine.

J.P. Morgan was voted into second place and Merrill Lynch third. The poll was conducted by EMI in August and sent to 1,000 debt and equity fund managers in Europe, the U.S. and Hong Kong. Respondents control assets of more than $40 billion.

Banks with the best overall emerging markets equity research were ING Barings, Merrill Lynch and J.P. Morgan, while best overall emerging market debt research were J.P. Morgan, Merrill Lynch and Citibank.

Best for Asia equity were Jardine Fleming, Credit Lyonnais Securities Asia and SBC Warburg. For Latin America it was ING Barings, Bear Stearns and Merrill Lynch, and for Emerging Europe, ING Barings, Merrill Lynch and MC Securities.
Respondents said the banks providing best advice on custody and settlement were Chase, State Street and HSBC Securities Services; best on foreign exchange were Citibank, Chase and HSBC Markets.
Those rated providing the most innovative structured products were Merrill Lynch, Robert/Jardine Fleming and Citibank.
